**Found it — one bug, in `src/pricing/engine.js`.**

The percent coupon rounds the running total to 2 cents *before* the currency change. That dropped fraction then gets multiplied by the rate, which is enough to push the final total across a cent boundary.

All 10 failures involve `SAVE10PCT`. `FLAT5` alone always passes, because `19.98 - 5` needs no rounding.

Why "most look fine": the loss only shows when the rate magnifies it. `GBP` and `CAD` fail; `USD` and `EUR` land on the same cent by luck.

The fix is to drop the two `round(..., 2)` calls on lines 24 and 27 and keep the single round at the end, which is what the test's reference already does.

`node --test tests/pricing-matrix.test.js` — 30 pass, 10 fail, 85ms.

```
2692 !== 2693
```

I have not changed any files. Want me to apply the fix?
